discovered_defects_fixed.fix: audit() clamps negative quantity to 0.0 with reason; rejects entry <= 0 with reason (both flow into valid=False; open_trade drops qty<=0).
discovered_defects_fixed.what: PositionManager.audit propagated negative quantity onto the corrected copy and passed through non-positive entries (only open_trade's qty<=0 check saved it).

documented_non_defects: Trade.result is trigger-based (SL-first naming) while canonical WIN/LOSS/BE is pnl-based via classify_pnl; backtester books via classify_pnl so economics are correct.
Walk-forward folds are gapless (test starts where train ends): no overlap, no leakage; a custom step < test_size would overlap TEST windows (operator choice, documented).

Sharpe/Sortino are trade-based position-return metrics (sample std n-1, sqrt(N), downside includes zeros, not annualized) -- must never be compared to standard annualized Sharpe. Verified by independent recomputation in tests.
